ownership: isolated recovery batch; worker B writes only its own claim/report/status files and isolated candidate sources under analysis/final-mix/recovery-experiments. Primary owns active sources, functions.tsv, layout.tsv, stage sync, full builds, manifests, receipts, Ghidra and HANDOFF.md.

selection.criteria: registered-but-unclaimed ranges absent from every worker-B round 1-18 claim; framed body opening with addiu sp,sp,-N and saving ra; no branch; 20-120 bytes; integer only
selection.note: ATTEMPTED harvested mechanically from every round-*/claim.json; round 9+ claims store dict entries with an 'address' field, so the harvest must read a.get('address') as well as plain strings.

compiler_use: No change to the shared stage, compiler flags or the reference executable. All compilation goes through Public/tools/kh2-audit/probe_fm_source.py on isolated candidate sources only.
verification_method: r19_dump_orig.py re-reads the original ELF, checks the whole-file sha256, verifies each range sha256 and its start/size against /root/kh2fm-build/layout.tsv, and disassembles with the pinned ee-objdump in kh2-local/ps2-compiler:3.2-ee-040921-objdiff.

round19_result.summary: 6 of 16 claimed ranges recovered byte-exact; 10 unresolved with measured blockers.

001d9eb0.mechanism: const u32 *DAT_01d59320-style vtable pointer stored as (u32)(long)&func_00352908, three stores after one call

001e0f90.mechanism: call, second call with the first result, then two stores to the derived pointer; the byte/word widths come straight off the machine

001b6d00.mechanism: non-volatile global keeps the single load in $t7 so the field access indexes it directly; __builtin_expect for the beqzl likely form

001c1890.mechanism: two calls through the same reloaded field, with a trailing asm volatile ("") to stop GCC tail-calling the second

00275ec8.mechanism: the global holds a pointer value, so it is declared volatile u32 and its address taken; that gives the target two independent lw instructions

unresolved.reason: one spurious andi t7,t7,0xffff: GCC zero-extends the lhu result before the shift, the original did not
same spurious andi, plus GCC materialises the +8 field offset as addiu t7,v0,8 + lw 0(t7) instead of a single lw t6,8(v0)

parked.reason: GCC normalises base+offset into the lui immediate: target addiu 0x1680 + lw 20(t6) becomes addiu 0x1694 + lw 0(t6). Same word addressed, different split.
ninth member of the round-14 func_002fd248 family, which is blocked because a body load's address-materialising lui is never scheduled into the prologue region
target interleaves ld ra between the two lh/store pairs; GCC hoists both lh together. asm barriers between the statements did not pin it.

compiler_level_findings: The spurious andi t7,t7,0xffff after an lhu feeding a shift: GCC 3.2 zero-extends the 16-bit load before the shift where the original compiler did not. Seven members of the 001bb9b0/001bbec0 family, one word each.
GCC normalises base+offset into the lui immediate when materialising a table address (001c5f38).
A body load's address-materialising lui is never scheduled into the prologue region (round 14 family, nine members including 001d5b78).
The $v0-vs-$t7 scratch choice, the leaf frame-pointer idiom, jalr $v0 dispatch, prologue sink and frameless tail-call thunks remain open as recorded in round-14/REPORT.md.
round19_result.process_note: Several sources in this round silently failed to compile because a template substitution dropped the func_ prefix, producing 'u32 001bbec0(void)'. Their absence of a verification json was initially misread as a link failure. Any stem should have its source checked for a valid func_<8 hex digits> name before its probe output is interpreted.
